title: 5.5 Wants and Needs
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Understand and produce simple want and need statements with first- and third-person subjects.
grammar_function: I/we/they want or need; he/she wants or needs. Meaning of need is supported by a clear lack or immediate physical context, never inferred from a neutral food image.
prerequisite: 3.8 Have and Has for third-person agreement; 4.7 Simple Present; 5.1-5.4 food language.
speaking_outcome: Say six short want/need sentences with the correct subject-verb chunk.

cards.pedagogy_note: New need chunk; context makes immediate need clear.
Introduces needs after she; concrete missing ingredient.
Tests desired item, not want/need contrast.
Text grammar contrast; incorrect form is never voiced as a model.
Reviews Unit 2 description; each distractor changes one feature.
Need cue is not just facial expression.
Direct audio-to-text meaning; both forms already taught.
Reviews some and subject; no image support.
Final -s is coached, not over-penalized outside policy.
